newsitem.title: POLAND: Warta 2.6 mln share issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Warta 2.6 mln share issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Five selected Polish investors subscribed for 3,022,829 shares in a February offering of up to 2,596,139 shares in Polish insurance firm TUiR Warta SA, Warta said in a statement on Tuesday.
Warta said Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA (PBK) subscribed for 1,514,414 shares, Kredyt Bank for 334,686 shares and Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH) for 312,500 shares.
Warta's shareholders Kulczyk Holding and Anna Wozniak subscribed for 746,229 shares 115,000 shares respectively.
The shares were priced at 48 zlotys each.

Warta earlier said about 75 percent of earnings from the issue would be used for acquisition of shares of banks from the treasury while the rest to develop its distribution network and infrastructure.
